title: Warm Smoky Peruvian Hearts Anticuchos
description: A rich and crunchy Peruvian dish featuring grilled beef heart skewers with a smoky flavor, served with a spicy Tabasco sauce, this ovo-vegetarian friendly version uses portobello mushrooms instead of beef heart, nostalgic and full of flavor

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and discarded, caps cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the mushroom pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the mushrooms with the beaten egg for a rich glaze.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and slightly charred.
While the mushrooms are grilling, mix the Tabasco sauce and lime juice in a small bowl.
Once the mushrooms are done, brush them with the Tabasco sauce mixture.
Serve the anticuchos warm, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
